frames.name: Title
frames.note: The black stage, corner scores, purple/gold logo, rainbow rules, and three text bands align. Logo letterforms and metallic bevels remain visibly different. Tribute wording replaces the original publisher promotion.

frames.name: Player setup
frames.note: Heading, name, colour label, eight swatches, Continue, and inactive HUD sit in the reference positions. The original futuristic font and more detailed silver tank are the largest differences.

frames.name: Weapon shop
frames.note: Two ten-row weapon columns, coloured inventory wells, pick arrow, Random, and bottom HUD reproduce the shop composition. Icons are original symbols, and typography and bevels are approximate.

frames.name: Spider impact
frames.note: The mountain silhouette, green strata, score corners, 69° / 76 controls, web streaks, and gold impact rings now correspond. Small tank geometry, web directions, exact explosion timing, and HUD artwork differ.

frames.name: Hail Storm
frames.note: Valley and cliff geometry, palette, 70° / 73 controls, and flowing blue particles correspond. Our effect is more segmented and less misty than the original; tank and font detail also remain approximate.

frames.name: Tommy Gun
frames.note: Plateau, steep drop, low right tank, 29° / 59 controls, and separated blue ballistic bullets correspond. Arc timing and spacing are close rather than identical; original font and tank model differ.

review: Subjective author assessment; not an independent or automated likeness score.
